title: Cross-mission canonical artifact input binding — governed consume of ACCEPTED artifacts from sibling missions
description: Fixes FAIL_CLOSED_PLAN_DATAFLOW_UNBOUND_INPUT for bound missions consuming artifacts ACCEPTED by earlier sibling missions. listEligibleExternalInputSources proves canonical lineage: validateWorkOpenBindingById (BOUND WOB<->delegated work item) + FULL assertCanonicalWorkforceAllocation on consumer and every sibling allocation (receipt + binding + WDEL + child graph + agent contract); tampered WDEL/forged membership/broken binding/cross-business/non-BOUND all throw FAIL_CLOSED_EXTERNAL_INPUT_LINEAGE. Reuse via late-bound registration (bindWorkforceAllocationProver/bindObjectiveWorkstreamCtor at owning-module eval; unbound = fail closed) — static import would pull business.ts into service.ts's import phase and crash work-completion's module-level MISSION_STATUS_TRANSITIONS read. F2: producerPassAnchored counts ALL anchored PASS validations (>1 = contradictory, closed) then requires the unique PASS artifact_ids contain the artifact; RUNNING/FAILED/unvalidated excluded. F3: cap on ELIGIBLE set only after filters; 63/64/65 boundary. F5: authorizeConsumeFetch resolves producer mission from the pinned producer execution row. F6: BOTH byte-consumption points (materializeForConsumer + authorizeConsumeFetch) re-prove CURRENT eligibility via the same seam before bytes are served/written — exact pinned identity match (artifact_id + producer exec/governed/task + producer mission + sha256), never filename; revoked lineage = zero bytes / zero writes; same-mission F2 untouched. Stamps pair_dataflow_sources (1 binds, 0 UNBOUND, >1 AMBIGUOUS, drift/conflict SOURCE_BINDING); assert re-proves CURRENT eligibility. 35 tests on canonical fixtures + adversarial (mid-flight revocation, contradictory PASS, wrong producer) + INT2 production path (real tick->commit->resolve/pin->REMOTE_FETCH bytes; governed rows fabricated — dispatch stays simulation) + cold-start smoke (dist index loads; bindings live). Regression 287 pass; baseline f4 R5.1-crash identical on BASE 1f6d4af.
